_comment: Component inventory: unverified means no measured model effect; safety evidence names behavior tests, not a causal performance claim. Change helps/no-effect only with fixed-task, order-swapped with/without evidence.

components.assumes: the model applies the selected chart style to the actual data and output format
the model asks the user to explain decisions without supplying their answers
the model traces the original response and execution path before retrying a failed operation
the model follows the supplied file scope and verification command without expanding the brief
the model selects relevant Solidity test patterns and checks meaningful failure cases
the model reads the workflow when a substantial task matches its description
the model uses observed prototype feedback to resolve product decisions
the model checks the target identity and current state before changing an issue
the model verifies the saved document against the requested content and layout
the model assigns independent tasks without overlapping write sets
the model keeps competing bug hypotheses independent until comparing evidence
the model states invariants and verifies correctness before claiming an optimization
the model derives criteria from real examples and gives an independent checker the actual artifact
the model distinguishes reusable feedback from a one-off task correction
the model recognizes applicable Solidity conventions at the changed call sites
the model converts the request into explicit deliverables, scope and checks without inventing requirements
the model distinguishes working progress from a verified completed outcome
the model checks share accounting and rounding against the vault invariants
the model checks auction pricing and fills against the accounting invariants
the model invokes checkout isolation on the intended repository
the model uses captured user answers when running comprehension checks
the model routes review through the review CLI for the current artifact
components.evidence: plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_cli.py; plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_review_policy.py test review routing and receipt requirements; model benefit is unmeasured

components.assumes: the model routes merges through the shipping CLI
components.evidence: plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_merge.py tests refusal without current verification and review evidence; model benefit is unmeasured

components.assumes: the model uses the verification CLI and supplies checks for the current tree
components.evidence: plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_evidence.py; plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_cli.py test verification evidence and binding behavior; model benefit is unmeasured

components.assumes: the model uses a host that loads the configured hooks for protected operations
components.evidence: plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_stop_hooks.py; plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_evidence.py; plugins/maeng-harness/tests/test_merge.py test hook notices, evidence capture and merge enforcement; model benefit is unmeasured

components.assumes: the model uses the role policy for task routing and reports unavailable execution resources
